description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 19.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names an official (Director General of Customs), this is for authority purposes only and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The content focuses entirely on regulatory implementation rather than government structure or personnel matters.
